title.narrative: Support for health promoters and midwives to establish basic health care in Guatemala
Unterstützung von Gesundheitspromotoren sowie Geburtshelferinnen zur Etablierung einer Basisgesundheitsversorgung in Guatemala

description.narrative: Many people in the project country, especially in rural regions, suffer from a lack of healthcare services, and this project is dedicated to addressing this problem. By supporting health promoters and midwives, the aim is to provide basic care in rural communities so that the most urgent emergencies can be treated. In addition, medical consultations are organised in the rural communities to enable further treatment. Durch die Begleitung von Gesundheitspromotor*innen sowie Geburtshelfer*innen soll in den ländlichen Gemeinden eine Basisversrogung ermögliicht werden, sodass die dringendsten Notfälle behandlet werden können.
